encoded_corrections.false_premise_not_restated: The task description's claim that this work is 'mechanical and behaviour-preserving by construction, requires no abstraction decision' is contradicted in the plan Overview and repeated nowhere.
encoded_corrections.nodup_hazard_resolution: Encoded as the phase dependency 4 -> 5, not as a note. Publishing mem_modalKnownWorlds first strands all six weak modalKnownWorlds_fold_spec_* copies with zero call sites; they are then deleted outright with no Nodup obligation and no call-site edits.
encoded_corrections.binder_conflict_resolution: 26 of 30 modalMaxWorld call sites use apply and are binder-mode insensitive. The 4 term-mode sites are named individually in Phase 6 (FmpMeasure ~1884, S5Simplification ~1167, FiveSimplification ~3328, LoopChecking ~6201) and are not assumed to be a clean sweep.
encoded_corrections.census_basis: Every deletion phase drives off a declaration-level suffix-family census, never the 'Local re-derivation' comment string. 17 duplicates carry no such comment; the comments are also unreliable in the other direction, falsely flagging byte-identical mem_modalUniverse_of.
encoded_corrections.partition: Two Support modules, not three. Support/Subfmls.lean explicitly dropped as a Non-Goal, since modalSubfmls/modalUniverse are defined in FmpMeasure itself and such a module would sit above it. Those 23 duplicates get in-place de-privatization (Phases 7-9). The 16 Tier-3 duplicates originating above FmpMeasure are accounted for in Phase 10, not left unmentioned.
encoded_corrections.justification_is_reachability: Recorded in both new modules' docstrings (Phase 2 and Phase 4 task lists): FiveSimplification, LoopChecking, and S5Simplification do not reach Soundness.lean, so de-privatization cannot fix hasEdge_addEdge_cases (7 copies). Also recorded that privacy is not the sole root cause - modalSubfmls_self_mem's copy dodges an ambient Hashable Atom instance callers cannot omit, and survives de-privatization (pre-declared Phase 10 exclusion).
encoded_corrections.shake_gate: Post-condition is 'no Modal/Tableau findings AND global count stays at 9', explicitly NOT 'exit 0'. Baseline is exit 1 with 9 pre-existing out-of-scope findings.
encoded_corrections.sorry_anchor: branchSatisfiableIn_s4FC_ancestor_redirect in FrameSoundness.lean, located by declaration NAME. The task description's line 1244 is stale - the declaration moved (~1252, token ~1276). The plan states this and forbids line-number anchoring.
encoded_corrections.do_not_edit_rationale: Zero duplicates live in Rules.lean, Saturation.lean, or Branch.lean. Branch.lean being the natural home for the 33 Tier-1 facts, and being do-not-edit, is exactly what makes a separate Support/ directory correct rather than arbitrary. Recorded in both new modules' docstrings so a later reader does not fold them back into Branch.lean.
encoded_corrections.free_wins: Phase 1 is the zero-risk phase: confirmed zero-call-site declarations (modalKnownWorlds_nodup_S5 and its helper modalKnownWorlds_fold_nodup_S5) plus the LoopChecking intra-file reorder that removes hasEdge_mem_successorsOf_origin.
encoded_corrections.phase_sizing: No phase deletes all 72 duplicates. Deletion is split into six batches (Phases 1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9) grouped by family and file, each bounded to roughly one agent run and each ending at a green lake build with per-substep commits.
